comment: Optional kit modules. The core install leaves these files out; crossbeam_get_skill serves each module as its own download. `when` is shown to agents on the install card and by `permitkit modules`, so it says when to offer the module, not only what needs it. permitkit/optional.py and mcp-server/scripts/skill-bundles.mjs both read this file. Paths are relative to the skill folder.

energy.title: Title 24 energy and CALGreen
energy.when: every California set drawn from scratch (its Title 24 energy and CALGreen sheets): ask the owner at the start of the set (references/02-path.md section 7). Also the energy or green block in project.json, the energy and green commands, T sheets

structural.title: Structural table checks and preliminary calcs
structural.when: every set drawn from scratch (its structural sheet): ask the owner at the start of the set (references/02-path.md section 7). Also the structure block in project.json, the struct command, framing sizes on a sheet

3d.title: 3D views
3d.when: the owner's choice: offer it at the start of the set (references/02-path.md section 7). Also the model3d block in project.json, a 3D view on a sheet
